comment: Add task-scoped capability tokens (coordinator_tasks start/progress/complete/abandon/heartbeat) and wire lease.FencingGuard onto them, closing the agent-dispatch-fleet-authority effort's Phase 1 authorization gap: a caller presenting only a narrow task-scoped token (never the shared bearer) can now act on exactly one task, with claims re-checked against that task's current owner/session/fencing-epoch on every call.
